Name: NoiseMaker
Description: Thrown device that rattles loudly, luring guards to investigate the sound.

Name: Lockpick
Description: Quietly defeats mechanical locks. Higher-security locks take longer to pick.

Name: HackingDevice
Description: Breaks into networked systems: cameras, terminals and electronic locks.

Name: Flashbang
Description: Blinds and deafens guards facing the burst. Very loud, use with care.

Name: SmokeGrenade
Description: Deploys a concealing cloud that breaks enemy sight lines for several seconds.

Name: StickyCamera
Description: Adheres to any surface and streams a remote feed. Can emit noise to distract.

Name: EMPDevice
Description: Disables cameras, terminals, alarms and lights in a wide radius for 30 seconds.

Name: FiberOpticCamera
Description: Slides under doors to reveal what waits on the other side.

Name: SurveillanceDetector
Description: Highlights nearby cameras and sensors, including their coverage cones.

Name: TearGasGrenade
Description: Area denial: forces guards out of a room and disrupts their aim.
